takes.h: Other Worlds Than These closes the Talisman trilogy
takes.p: Stephen King and Peter Straub's Other Worlds Than These, the third and final Talisman book, came out from Scribner on October 6. It runs 624 pages and carries 38 black-and-white illustrations by Gabriel Rodríguez. The audiobook is narrated by Patton Oswalt.
